mechanism: Cefepime may accumulate in renal impairment and theoretically increase CNS penetration, while tizanidine undergoes hepatic metabolism and renal clearance; combined use in patients with renal dysfunction could elevate tizanidine levels and CNS effects.
action: Monitor renal function and tizanidine efficacy; dose adjustment may be necessary if significant renal impairment (CrCl <25 mL/min) is present; no dose adjustment typically required with normal renal function.
